trans-unit.source: Keep it saves this check as payment run evidence. For each ticked line whose action is Hold, it checks the line again and deletes it from this payment journal. For a bank change, an unusual amount or a first payment it puts every invoice the line pays on hold with the Hold Code from the setup, otherwise only the possible duplicate, so the next Suggest Vendor Payments skips them. Credit memos are never put on hold, and a line that pays nothing still open is only removed. A line already exported to a payment file or with a printed check stops Keep it. All other lines stay in the journal unchanged. Nothing is posted, no payment file is exported and no bank details are changed. The journal's Payment run review panel shows the latest check.
